steps.npc: Tread carefully in this hallowed place, traveller. The magicks of the Dark Altar are not to be treated lightly.
The Dark Altar is the treasure of Arceuus. Our forebears spent their lives - literally, in some cases - learning to unlock its secrets and wield its power.
The power of the Dark Altar, reflected in these great crystals, can twist dimensions, warp minds, and even bridge the gulf between life and death.

options.text: Can I try the magicks myself?
options.condition: If the player is not on the Arceuus spellbook:

steps.player: Can I try the magicks myself?

steps.npc: Very well. If you find an ensouled cadaver in your travels, you may attempted to reanimate it with the magicks I have placed in your mind.

options.text: I'd like to stop using your spellbook now.
options.condition: If the player is on the Arceuus spellbook:

steps.player: I'd like to stop using your spellbook now.

steps.npc: Very well, the magicks of the Dark Altar have been lifted from your mind.

steps.text: If the player has 100% Arceuus favour and a full inventory:

steps.npc: I suppose you are a friend to us. Free up some space and I will give you something.

steps.text: If the player has 100% Arceuus favour:

steps.npc: I suppose you are a friend to us. Here, you may have this.

steps.text: Tyss gives you a signet in the shape of a crystal from the Dark Altar.

options.text: Can I have an ash sanctifier, please?

steps.player: Can I have an ash sanctifier, please?

steps.text: If the player has not completed the Hard Kourend & Kebos Diary:

steps.npc: No. You need to complete all of the hard tasks in your Kourend & Kebos Achievement Diary.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have an ash sanctifier and has a full inventory:

steps.npc: Not unless you make space to carry it, traveller.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have an ash sanctifier:

steps.npc: Thanks for your efforts throughout the tasks set. Here, you may have this.

steps.text: If the player has an ash sanctifier in their inventory or their bank:

steps.npc: You already appear to own such a device, traveller.

options.text: Can I sacrifice trophy heads on the altar?

steps.player: Can I sacrifice my trophy heads on the altar?

steps.npc: Yes, I believe the Dark Altar may even reward you for such a sacrifice.
